title: Can subthreshold micropulse yellow laser treatment change the anti-vascular endothelial growth factor algorithm in diabetic macular edema? A randomized clinical trial

license.statement: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 License); PRIVATE

condition: Treatment-naive centre-involving diabetic macular edema in type 2 diabetes (CMT >= 300 µm, no ischaemic maculopathy or PDR); prospective randomised 1:1 two-centre comparison (Istanbul, April 2015 to November 2017), 56 patients/eyes, 12 months

groups.description: IAI monotherapy: three monthly loading injections, then PRN (paused when stable; resumed for a loss of more than one BCVA line or a CMT increase of at least 20%)

groups.agent: aflibercept 2 mg intravitreal plus subthreshold micropulse yellow laser (577 nm, 5% duty cycle)
groups.description: Combination: three monthly aflibercept loading injections, SMYL one month after loading (or after one more injection if CMT stayed above 450 µm), then PRN with SMYL repeats; described by the article as one of 'two coexisting standard treatments'

series.notes: Mean ± SD (Results text reports the same cells as means ± SD); Table 2 header row R3 is offset (its 12 sub-headers start at C1 while data rows carry the label in C1), so data cells C2/C5/C8/C11 are Mono. and C3/C6/C9/C12 are Comb.; '1 Month after loading' = month 3 (loading injections at months 0, 1 and 2 at 1-month intervals, visit one month after the third); per-visit n not reported
Mean ± SD; same column layout and timing as the monotherapy series; SMYL was first applied after the month-3 visit

exclusions.what: Table 2 BCVA, BCVA (LogMar) and SFCT rows
exclusions.reason: visual acuity and choroidal thickness are not extracted / out of scope

exclusions.what: Numbers of injections and SMYL sessions, retreatment proportions

notes: Time origin: the first loading aflibercept injection after eligibility at the baseline examination
OCT device printed as 'Nikon RS-3000' (SD-OCT; device other); CMT is not defined beyond 'with foveal involvement', so measure central_unspecified
Roles: the article states both arms are 'two coexisting standard treatments' (randomised parallel 1:1), so both groups are control; the combination arm declares treatment combination
